text: quick-model-widget 是一个面向 DSH Web 的模型快捷切换小部件，插入会话输入框右侧。它读取当前会话可用模型，并在输入区显示最近使用的最多三个模型与推理档位；点击条目后通过 DSH 会话接口选择对应模型。新选择会追加到列表，超过三项时移除最旧项，选择历史保存在浏览器 localStorage。适合希望减少打开完整模型选择器次数、快速往返常用模型的 DSH Web 用户。代码没有声明额外 API Key 或外部服务配置。

quick-model-widget adds a switcher beside the DSH Web composer. It shows up to three recent models and reasoning efforts, and clicking one selects it in the current session. Choices are saved in browser localStorage; a fourth replaces the oldest.
想在 DSH 输入框旁放几个最近用过的模型，点一下就能切回去。
DSH 能不能记住我常用的模型和推理档位，方便快速切换？
I want to switch back to one of my last few models right from the chat composer.
quick-model-widget 的功能「最近模型快捷切换」：输入框旁会列出最多三个近期模型及推理档位。点击条目后使用当前会话的模型选择接口切换；历史保存在浏览器本地，新增第四项时淘汰最旧项。

quick-model-widget README · quick-model-widget：A real DSH Web plugin that adds a compact model + reasoning quick-switcher to the composer. It keeps the last three distinct choices in browser `localStorage`.

quick-model-widget README · Behavior：- Existing choices keep their position when selected.
- New choices append on the right.
- Adding a fourth distinct choice removes the oldest item on the left.
- Each button uses DSH's existing host-backed model selection path.
- The normal full model selector remains available.

quick-model-widget README · Install from this checkout：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/home/ubuntu/debug/quick-model-widget
```

Restart the DSH web process, then refresh `http://127.0.0.1:3080`.

quick-model-widget README · Install from GitHub：After publishing this folder to a public repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:user/quick-model-widget
```

or:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/user/quick-model-widget.git
```

The package declares both `dsh.bundle` (to add its row to the profile) and `dsh.client` (to serve and load the browser bundle).

quick-model-widget README · Remove：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove quick-model-widget
```

Restart DSH after adding or removing a profile plugin.

quick-model-widget README · Files：- `src/client.js` — readable Client plugin source.
- `lib/client.js` — browser bundle loaded by DSH.
- `lib/index.js` — no-op Host half required by DSH composition.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — profile row added during installation.
- `quick-model-widget.js` — reusable selection/history helpers.
